doc: Fill in, save as edits.json, then: python3 course_data/mapper/write_layers.py sand_creek_station. See course_data/mapper/BRIEF.md for ops, shapes and rules. s2_suggested: Sentinel-2 native candidates (hint, not a layer): per hole and side set every candidate's decision to accept (its shape becomes add native with your confidence + evidence; the 10-yd keep-out applies), reject (evidence = why) or replace (you drew your own native edit in `edits`, e.g. the traced edge); undecided ones are listed in review.md.
